_about: Settings for scripts/collect-vuln-news.mjs (소식 > 취약점 소식; runs with the security news job, free sources only). Korean media only. A story is added when minOutlets outlets reported it, when a KISA 보안공지 about the same product came out within a week, or when one outlet in trustedSources (security trade press) reported it and it names a product, a CVE id, a patch or an attack. Headlines and links come from the first report by an outlet in preferSources when there is one. The how-to steps live in src/data/vuln-howto.json.
